name: SunSetRefugeeCamp
source:
Post-Apoclyptic visual novel demo where you play as a girl trying to unravel the mystery of her father's disappearance and she meets a team of special people who help her through the way.

[From [url=https://violegrace.itch.io/ssrc]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
后世界末日视觉小说演示，你扮演一个女孩，试图解开她父亲失踪的谜团，她遇到了一群特殊的人，他们帮助她度过了难关。

[来自[url=https://violegrace.itch.io/ssrc]itch.io[/url]]
